correctness.rationale: Integrating the stationary covariance gives a=Cov(J,X(x)) and a'=b=Cov(J,X'(x)); the observation block is diagonal with entries 1+1/p and λ²+1/q because the same-site cross covariance and noise cross covariance vanish. This gives the two-term reduction, including omitted channels by continuity. On the left half, b>0 away from the midpoint, b'<0, and a+b'/λ²=2(2−K(x,0)−K(x,1))/λ>0, so noiseless a²+b²/λ² increases strictly. To justify finite-budget uniqueness rather than just a limit, set h=a_c²−a². With y=1/2−x and d=λ²e^(−λ/2), b∼dy and h∼a_c d y². Thus b²/(λ²h) extends to the midpoint with value d/(λ²a_c)<1, and its maximum ρ on the half interval is less than 1. The off-center gain is at most a²P/(1+P)+b²/λ², strictly below midpoint value-only gain when P>ρ/(1−ρ). For λ=8 at small P, the normalized objective in (x,p/P) converges uniformly to a convex combination of a² and b²; b(0)>a_c gives a unique maximizing corner on the left half. Both inward partials there are strictly negative and stay negative in a small rectangle, so compactness confines every maximizer to that rectangle and the corner is attained exactly. At P=1/20 the global pure maxima are a_c²/21 and b(0)²/84 from monotonicity. Independent rational arithmetic verifies the lower bounds 5507441/3688388100096 for mixed witness minus best gradient and 491/1835008 for best gradient minus best value. Strictness and continuity preserve the witness in an open parameter neighborhood. Reflection and compactness supply all quantifiers in the statement.
residual_risks: No assertion of a large-budget threshold uniform in λ, precise phase boundaries, or location of the mixed optima.

value.rationale: Even for a single predetermined common site, the global design needs different kinds of measurements at different budgets: derivative only, strictly mixed, and eventually value only. The mixed witness eliminates a pure-channel rule over all locations and holds on an open set, rather than winning at one handpicked site against a weak baseline. The eventual uniqueness proof addresses finite budgets, not merely noiseless convergence. These are useful sharp qualitative tests of budgeted derivative-enhanced design under the stated channel cost model.
residual_risks: Absolute noise precision is unit-dependent. No empirical advantage or full phase diagram, or transfer to standardized costs, is established.
